items.title: Ethical Use of Data and Models

source_refs.note: 'Ethical Use of Data and Models' under topic 7.6, as printed (PDF 102, printed 98).

blocks.text: Ethical use of data involves respecting privacy and confidentiality of individuals. Data should be collected with proper consent and used only for intended purposes. Machine learning models must be designed to avoid discrimination. Sensitive data should be protected from unauthorized access. Ethical guidelines help prevent misuse of predictive models. Transparency in model design builds trust among users. Responsible use of data and models ensures positive social impact.
